title: apply's lead-passage row is refused when the lead does not answer: no route miss, the lead line holds most of the question's key words
goal: ql_apply.from_lead skips a rules finding whose observed route is miss, and a lead-passage row is tried only when the lead line holds most of the question's key words, since an _self eval row passes on anchor-in-doc plus phrase-in-pack (_tools/rag.py:290-299) and so a lead that does not answer still passes the gates; one planted failure pins a lead that does not answer staying no-fix, and kb/_self/querylog.md (Apply, Rules findings) stops saying a wrong lead fails the eval.
